invariants.rationale: atlas.findRegion(regionName) typically returns a non-null TextureRegion if a matching region exists in the atlas; the method is expected to return a valid region.
The method's return type guarantees this will hold, as 'result' will either be a TextureRegion or null.
A valid TextureRegion should have a non-negative width; null check is required for safety.
A valid TextureRegion should have a non-negative height; null check is required for safety.
If a TextureRegion is returned, its underlying texture should not be null.
